events.verdict: Sasser (DET) swipes down and avoids making contact with Connaughton's (MIL) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Smith (DET) moves his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.
Waters III (DET) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves alongside Connaughton (MIL).
Smith (DET) firms up in a screening position and extends slightly to the side as Connaughton (MIL) moves around him.
Nance (MIL) legally contests Smith's (DET) shot attempt.
Klintman (DET) extends his hands into Smith's (MIL) back, dislodging him from his position.
Smith (DET) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Bouyea's (MIL) driving shot attempt.
Smith (MIL) legally contests Klintman's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MIL) and Klintman (DET) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Sasser (DET) swipes down and initiates illegal contact with Bouyea's (MIL) arm that affects his SQBR.
Nance (MIL) legally contests Waters III's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Waters III (DET) moves laterally toward Connaughton (MIL) as he gathers into his shooting motion and the body contact is marginal.
